name: Acme_NewsAgent
author: Acme (example)
description: Reference agent plugin (AGENT-REGISTRY-1, docs/AGENT-REGISTRY.md section 7): an agent built with no code orchestration. One agent (acme-news, with a schedule), one feed-fetch tool (acme_news_fetch: plain HTTP, RSS/Atom/text) and a periodic feed refresh that keeps the agent's instructions carrying the latest headlines. Copy it as a community module and grant it in modules.json: daemon.code, daemon.tool, daemon.env:ACME_NEWS_FEED_URL, agents.contribute.

agents.name: News
agents.description: Reads a news feed and briefs you in the chat.
agents.instructions: You are a news desk. Use the acme_news_fetch tool to read the feed, then answer with a short briefing: the top items, one line each, newest first. Never invent an item that is not in the feed.

schedule.prompt: Brief me on what is new in the feed since your last briefing.

tools.name: acme_news_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a news feed (plain HTTP/HTTPS, RSS, Atom or text) and list its item titles.
